title:
Comment of Randy Kalp in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151657.txt
documents.text:
Randy Kalp, Barnstable, MA.
To the Commission:
I am writing to oppose the preliminary permit for the proposed underwater data center in the Bay of Fundy off Eastport, Maine.
DeepGreen Western Passage SPV LLC applied for a 48-month preliminary permit to conduct engineering and environmental studies for a project that would cover about 27 acres in the Bay of Fundy at depths of roughly 150 to 400 feet. A preliminary permit does not authorize construction, but it gives the applicant priority over competing applicants. That is the wrong foundation for a project in waters this sensitive.
The Bay of Fundy is critical habitat for endangered North Atlantic right whales, a species with only a few hundred individuals remaining. These waters also anchor Maine’s fishing economy, and lobstermen have objected over effects on the marine ecosystem. Local fishermen and aquaculture operators have raised unmitigated risks of thermal pollution, and the effects of noise, seafloor disruption, and heat discharge at this site have not been adequately studied.
The Passamaquoddy Tribe at Sipayik has denounced the project and rejected any future collaboration with DeepGreen, citing its responsibility to protect the bay’s fisheries and cultural resources. The Commission should not advance this application without government-to-government consultation with the Passamaquoddy Tribe and other Wabanaki nations.
Local opposition is broad. Eastport’s City Council voted unanimously for a 180-day moratorium, and residents, fishermen, and county officials have spoken against the project.
I urge the Commission to deny the permit. If it is not denied, I ask that any study plan require full Endangered Species Act consultation, independent analysis of thermal and acoustic impacts, and meaningful engagement with the Passamaquoddy Tribe, Eastport residents, and the fishing community.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
